scope: v2 artifact schema, checkpoint identities, resume granularity, atomic commit, failure/restart matrix for the unpublished forward-drizzle-v2 band pipeline. Library-level contract; not wired into the production runner.

rejected.reason: spec section 18.2 permits it, but it discards up to a whole reconstruction phase of durable band work; band artifacts are already the bounded, deterministic unit produced by finalize.

would require persisting the complete per-pixel accumulator and reservoir workspace (the full device state); transient by design and consumed at finalize. Rejected as disproportionate and unbounded relative to the band artifact.

resume_granularity_decision.rule: Resume is possible exclusively at atomically committed band boundaries. A partially written or uncommitted band is discarded and recomputed. A phase event alone never establishes resumability; only checkpoint.json content does.

files.plan.json: binding run plan, written first, immutable afterwards
files.checkpoint.json: committed band prefix, rewritten atomically after every band commit
files.band-%04d.bin: self-describing binary band artifact: 64-byte fixed header + record_count * 64-byte ForwardDrizzleV2PixelResult records
files.commit.json: final marker inside the generation, written only after full re-verification and commit-gate checks

artifact_layout.pointer: current.json at the store root; written atomically as the LAST step of publish; identical content to commit.json plus the generation name

plan_binding_fields: native geometry: width, height, channels, internal_scale, color_mode, pixfrac, bayer/cfa
plan_hash = sha256 over the canonical serialization of every field above

checkpoint_identity.checkpoint_hash: sha256 over canonical serialization; recomputed on every read
checkpoint_identity.ordering_invariant: bands form a contiguous prefix of band indices 0..k-1 with contiguous y ranges

atomic_commit_order_per_band: 1. write band payload to a uniquely staged sibling inside the unpublished generation (AtomicOutput)
2. fsync payload, rename to band-%04d.bin, fsync directory
3. compute sha256 of the committed artifact
4. rewrite checkpoint.json atomically with the new band appended (commit mark LAST)
publication_order: 1. all band artifacts committed and checkpointed
2. finish(): verify bands == band_count and contiguous, re-verify every artifact (size + sha256), evaluate commit gates
3. write commit.json atomically inside the generation
4. write current.json atomically at the root (last step)
5. a writer destroyed without publish removes only its own unpublished generation; after a publication attempt the generation is never deleted

commit_gates.nonfinite_pixels_inside_source_support: must be 0, else finish() throws and the generation stays unpublished
commit_gates.telemetry: caller-supplied JSON recorded verbatim in commit.json

inspection_order: current.json present -> validate schema, generation existence, commit_hash and plan_hash -> complete

no current.json, exactly one generation dir -> verify plan.json (parse + plan_hash vs expected), verify checkpoint.json (hash, plan_hash, contiguous prefix), verify every listed artifact (exists, size, sha256) -> resumable at k
no current.json, more than one generation -> ambiguous -> corrupt (fail closed)
fail_closed: unparseable or hash-mismatched plan.json or checkpoint.json
plan_hash differs from the expected plan
checkpoint lists a band whose artifact is missing, truncated or hash-mismatched
current.json pointing at a missing or hash-mismatched generation
resume_semantics.ignored_state: artifacts or stage directories present but not listed in checkpoint.json are uncommitted residue of an interrupted band write; they are ignored and overwritten by the recomputation
resume_semantics.verification_cost_note: size + sha256 verification runs once per phase resume on derived output artifacts, never in the frame hot path; trusted-run source payload hashing stays untouched

determinism_requirement: an uninterrupted run and a crash-resumed run over identical inputs produce byte-identical band artifacts, the same plan_hash and the same checkpoint_hash; commit.json content is identical modulo the per-run generation directory name (which enters commit_hash by design)
out_of_scope: wiring into persist_forward_drizzle_multiband or the production runner
local warp checkpoint fields beyond the placeholder
